what_to_detect: A transfigure ability resolves and puts a creature card from its controller's library onto the battlefield.
near_miss: A transfigure ability resolves and finds no creature card with the same mana value, so nothing enters.
record_fields: zone_change events of the resolution's effect half
acting line keyword_display_name (a keyword line's script_api_type is Keyword, so api cannot select it)

what_to_detect: A transfigure ability candidate passes its timing check in its controller's main phase with an empty stack.
near_miss: A transfigure ability candidate fails its timing check outside a main phase or with a nonempty stack.
